# Set Up
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

Packages <- c(
  "readxl", "stats", "ggfortify", "ggrepel", "svglite", "Biobase",
  "ComplexHeatmap", "limma", "tidyverse", "ropls", "cowplot", "UpSetR"
)

lapply(Packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
```

```{r source_functions, include=FALSE}
source("functions.R")
source("missingness_visualization_functions.R")
```

## Load Dataset(s)

```{r LoadDataset, include=FALSE}
batch2_peak_area           <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/batch2_peak_area_clean.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
batch2_compound_annotation <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/batch2_metabolite_annotations_flagged.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
batch2_sample_metadata     <- read_csv('../../results/untargeted/batch2_sample_metadata.csv',
                                       show_col_types = FALSE)
 
cat("Compounds loaded:", nrow(batch2_peak_area), "\n")
```

## Build Full ExpressionSet

```{r prep_dataframe}
final_matrix <- batch2_peak_area %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("Sample"))

compounds_in_peak <- unique(batch2_peak_area$Compound.ID)

batch2_compound_annotation <- batch2_compound_annotation %>%
  filter(Compound.ID %in% compounds_in_peak) %>%
  arrange(match(Name, rownames(final_matrix)))

metabolite_names <- batch2_compound_annotation$Name
final_matrix <- apply(final_matrix, 2, as.numeric)
rownames(final_matrix) <- metabolite_names

batch2_sample_metadata <- batch2_sample_metadata %>%
  filter(Sample %in% colnames(final_matrix)) %>%
  arrange(match(Sample, colnames(final_matrix)))

sample_metadata_df <- as.data.frame(batch2_sample_metadata)
rownames(sample_metadata_df) <- sample_metadata_df$Sample
sample_phenoData <- AnnotatedDataFrame(sample_metadata_df)

metabolite_metadata_df <- as.data.frame(batch2_compound_annotation)
rownames(metabolite_metadata_df) <- metabolite_metadata_df$Name
metabolite_featureData <- AnnotatedDataFrame(metabolite_metadata_df)

batch2_metabolomics <- ExpressionSet(
  assayData = final_matrix,
  phenoData = sample_phenoData,
  featureData = metabolite_featureData
)
```

```{r log_transform}
exprs(batch2_metabolomics) <- log2(exprs(batch2_metabolomics) + 1)
cat("Log2 transformation applied.\n")
cat("Intensity range after:", range(exprs(batch2_metabolomics), na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

---

# Define Steroid Subgroups

```{r define_subgroups}
annotation_full <- fData(batch2_metabolomics)

# --- Broad: all steroids and steroid derivatives by Class ---
broad_names <- annotation_full %>%
  filter(Class == "Steroids and steroid derivatives") %>%
  pull(Name)

cat("--- Sub.Class values in broad steroid set ---\n")
annotation_full %>%
  filter(Class == "Steroids and steroid derivatives") %>%
  count(Sub.Class) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()

# --- Strict: gonadal + adrenal steroids and cholesterol by Sub.Class ---
# Targets: androgens, estrogens, progestogens, glucocorticoids,
#          mineralocorticoids, cholesterol
strict_names <- annotation_full %>%
  filter(Sub.Class %in% c(
    "Androstane steroids",
    "Estrane steroids",
    "Pregnane steroids",
    "Hydroxysteroids",
    "Cholestane steroids"
  )) %>%
  pull(Name)

cat("=== Steroid Subgroup Sizes ===\n")
cat("Broad (Class == Steroids and steroid derivatives):", length(broad_names), "compounds\n")
cat("Strict (gonadal + adrenal + cholesterol by Sub.Class):", length(strict_names), "compounds\n\n")

# Preview what the strict filter captured
cat("Strict Sub.Class values detected:\n")
annotation_full %>%
  filter(Name %in% strict_names) %>%
  count(Sub.Class) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r build_esets}
# Subset ExpressionSets
subset_eset <- function(eset, names_keep) {
  idx <- featureNames(eset) %in% names_keep
  eset[idx, ]
}

eset_broad <- subset_eset(batch2_metabolomics, broad_names)
eset_strict <- subset_eset(batch2_metabolomics, strict_names)

analyses_list <- list(broad = eset_broad, strict = eset_strict)

cat("ExpressionSet sizes:\n")
cat("  Broad: ", nrow(eset_broad), "features x", ncol(eset_broad), "samples\n")
cat("  Strict:", nrow(eset_strict), "features x", ncol(eset_strict), "samples\n")
```

---

# Analyses (Looped over Broad and Strict)

```{r main_loop}
for (scope in names(analyses_list)) {
  eset <- analyses_list[[scope]]

  # Output paths scoped by broad/strict
  png_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_steroids", scope)
  svg_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_steroids", scope, "svg")
  csv_path <- file.path("../../results/untargeted/batch2_steroids", scope, "csv")
  dir.create(png_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(svg_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(csv_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cat("\n", rep("=", 80), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("SCOPE:", toupper(scope), "\n")
  cat(rep("=", 80), "\n\n", sep = "")

  n_features <- nrow(eset)
  cat("Compounds in this subgroup:", n_features, "\n\n")

  # ── Compound Inventory ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("--- Compound Inventory ---\n")
  inventory <- fData(eset) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, Sub.Class, Class) %>%
    arrange(Sub.Class, Name)
  print(inventory)
  write_csv(
    inventory,
    file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_inventory.csv"))
  )

  metadata_loop <- pData(eset)
  GW <- metadata_loop$GW
  sex_groups <- metadata_loop$Sex

  # ── GW Correlation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- GW Correlation ---\n")

  correlation_test <- function(x, y) {
    result <- cor.test(x, y)
    c(correlation = result$estimate, p_value = result$p.value)
  }

  gw_corr_stats <- data.frame(
    Name = fData(eset)$Name,
    GW_corr_pval = t(apply(exprs(eset), 1, function(x) correlation_test(x, GW)))
  ) %>%
    mutate(GW_FDR = p.adjust(GW_corr_pval.p_value, method = "fdr"))

  # Plot all compounds (subset is small enough)
  gw_corr_all <- gw_corr_stats %>%
    mutate(
      Name_display = truncate_labels(Name),
      Significant = GW_FDR < 0.05,
      FDR_label = case_when(
        GW_FDR < 0.001 ~ "***",
        GW_FDR < 0.01 ~ "**",
        GW_FDR < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

  scatter_GW <- ggplot(
    gw_corr_all,
    aes(
      x = reorder(Name_display, GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor),
      y = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor
    )
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(
      size = -log10(GW_corr_pval.p_value),
      color = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor
    )) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = FDR_label,
        y = GW_corr_pval.correlation.cor + 0.03
      ),
      size = 3, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_color_gradient2(
      low = "tomato", mid = "grey90", high = "steelblue",
      midpoint = 0, name = "Correlation"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Compound",
      y = "Correlation with GW",
      title = paste0("GW Correlations - Steroids (", scope, ")"),
      size = "-log10(p)"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  save_dual_format(scatter_GW, paste0("gw_correlation_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
    label_lookup = build_label_lookup(gw_corr_all$Name)
  )
  print(scatter_GW)
  write_csv(
    gw_corr_stats,
    file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_gw_correlation.csv"))
  )

  # ── GW limma ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- GW limma ---\n")

  design_gw <- model.matrix(~GW, data = metadata_loop)
  fit_gw <- lmFit(exprs(eset), design_gw)
  fit_gw <- eBayes(fit_gw)
  gw_limma_results <- topTable(fit_gw,
    coef = "GW", number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
    left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
      by = "Name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Increases with GW", "Decreases with GW"),
      FDR_label = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        adj.P.Val < 0.01 ~ "**",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

  cat("GW limma - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(gw_limma_results$P.Value < 0.05), "\n")
  cat("GW limma - FDR < 0.05:", sum(gw_limma_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

  gw_bar_data <- gw_limma_results %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))

  gw_bar <- ggplot(
    gw_bar_data,
    aes(x = reorder(Name, logFC), y = logFC, fill = Direction)
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = FDR_label,
        hjust = ifelse(logFC > 0, -0.2, 1.2)
      ),
      size = 4, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(gw_bar_data$Name_display, gw_bar_data$Name)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Increases with GW" = "steelblue",
      "Decreases with GW" = "tomato"
    )) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Compound",
      y = "Slope (log2 peak area per GW week)",
      title = paste0("GW-Associated Steroids - limma (", scope, ")"),
      caption = "* FDR < 0.05   ** FDR < 0.01   *** FDR < 0.001"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )

  save_dual_format(gw_bar, paste0("gw_limma_bar_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
    label_lookup = build_label_lookup(gw_bar_data$Name)
  )
  print(gw_bar)
  write_csv(
    gw_limma_results,
    file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_gw_limma.csv"))
  )

  # ── Sex Wilcoxon ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- Sex Wilcoxon ---\n")

  wilcoxon_test <- function(x, sex) {
    valid_idx <- !is.na(x)
    x_clean <- x[valid_idx]
    sex_clean <- sex[valid_idx]
    if (length(unique(sex_clean)) < 2) {
      return(c(statistic = NA, p_value = NA))
    }
    result <- wilcox.test(x_clean[sex_clean == "F"],
      x_clean[sex_clean == "M"],
      exact = FALSE
    )
    c(statistic = as.numeric(result$statistic), p_value = result$p.value)
  }

  wilcoxon_results <- t(apply(exprs(eset), 1, wilcoxon_test, sex = sex_groups))
  colnames(wilcoxon_results) <- c("statistic", "p_value")

  mean_male <- apply(exprs(eset)[, sex_groups == "M", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  mean_female <- apply(exprs(eset)[, sex_groups == "F", drop = FALSE], 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)

  metabolite_sex_stats <- data.frame(
    Name = fData(eset)$Name,
    Compound.ID = fData(eset)$Compound.ID,
    Wilcoxon_statistic = wilcoxon_results[, "statistic"],
    p_value = wilcoxon_results[, "p_value"],
    Mean_Female = mean_female,
    Mean_Male = mean_male,
    logFC = log2(mean_male / mean_female)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      FDR = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"),
      Bonferroni = p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni"),
      Significant_FDR = FDR < 0.05,
      Significant_Bonferroni = Bonferroni < 0.05,
      Direction = case_when(
        logFC > 0 ~ "Higher in Males",
        logFC < 0 ~ "Higher in Females",
        TRUE ~ "No difference"
      ),
      Name_display = truncate_labels(Name)
    )

  sig_metabolites_fdr <- metabolite_sex_stats %>% filter(p_value < 0.05)

  cat("Sex Wilcoxon - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(metabolite_sex_stats$p_value < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Sex Wilcoxon - FDR < 0.05:", sum(metabolite_sex_stats$Significant_FDR, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

  volcano_FDR <- ggplot(metabolite_sex_stats, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(p_value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Significant_FDR), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_metabolites_fdr,
      aes(label = Name_display),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
      name = "FDR < 0.05"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
      y = "-log10(p-value)",
      title = paste0("Sex Differential - Volcano (FDR) - Steroids (", scope, ")")
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  save_dual_format(volcano_FDR, paste0("sex_volcano_FDR_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
    label_lookup = build_label_lookup(metabolite_sex_stats$Name)
  )
  print(volcano_FDR)

  volcano_Bonferroni <- ggplot(metabolite_sex_stats, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(p_value))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Significant_Bonferroni), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_metabolites_fdr,
      aes(label = Name_display),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
      name = "Bonferroni < 0.05"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
      y = "-log10(p-value)",
      title = paste0("Sex Differential - Volcano (Bonferroni) - Steroids (", scope, ")")
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  save_dual_format(volcano_Bonferroni, paste0("sex_volcano_Bonferroni_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
    label_lookup = build_label_lookup(metabolite_sex_stats$Name)
  )
  print(volcano_Bonferroni)

  write_csv(
    metabolite_sex_stats,
    file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_sex_wilcoxon.csv"))
  )

  # ── Sex limma ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- Sex limma ---\n")

  metadata_limma <- pData(eset)
  metadata_limma$Sex <- factor(metadata_limma$Sex, levels = c("F", "M"))
  design_sex <- model.matrix(~Sex, data = metadata_limma)

  fit_sex <- lmFit(exprs(eset), design_sex)
  fit_sex <- eBayes(fit_sex)
  sex_limma_results <- topTable(fit_sex,
    coef = "SexM", number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
  ) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Name") %>%
    left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
      by = "Name"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Higher in Males", "Higher in Females"),
      FDR_label = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.001 ~ "***",
        adj.P.Val < 0.01 ~ "**",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "*",
        TRUE ~ ""
      )
    )

  cat("Sex limma - nominal p < 0.05:", sum(sex_limma_results$P.Value < 0.05), "\n")
  cat("Sex limma - FDR < 0.05:", sum(sex_limma_results$adj.P.Val < 0.05), "\n")

  volcano_sex_limma <- ggplot(
    sex_limma_results,
    aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))
  ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = adj.P.Val < 0.05), alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sex_limma_results %>% filter(P.Value < 0.05),
      aes(label = truncate_labels(Name)),
      size = 3, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c("FALSE" = "grey", "TRUE" = "red"),
      name = "FDR < 0.05"
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
      y = "-log10(p-value)",
      title = paste0("Sex Differential - limma Volcano - Steroids (", scope, ")"),
      caption = "Positive logFC = higher in males"
    ) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  save_dual_format(volcano_sex_limma, paste0("sex_limma_volcano_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path
  )
  print(volcano_sex_limma)

  sex_bar_data <- sex_limma_results %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(logFC))) %>%
    mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))

  sex_bar <- ggplot(
    sex_bar_data,
    aes(x = reorder(Name, logFC), y = logFC, fill = Direction)
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = FDR_label,
        hjust = ifelse(logFC > 0, -0.2, 1.2)
      ),
      size = 4, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(sex_bar_data$Name_display, sex_bar_data$Name)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "Higher in Males" = "steelblue",
      "Higher in Females" = "tomato"
    )) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      x = "Compound",
      y = "Log2 Fold Change (Male/Female)",
      title = paste0("Sex-Differential Steroids - limma (", scope, ")"),
      caption = "* FDR < 0.05   ** FDR < 0.01   *** FDR < 0.001"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
    )

  save_dual_format(sex_bar, paste0("sex_limma_bar_", scope),
    png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
    label_lookup = build_label_lookup(sex_bar_data$Name)
  )
  print(sex_bar)
  write_csv(
    sex_limma_results,
    file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_sex_limma.csv"))
  )

  # ── GW limma trajectories (nominal p < 0.05) ──────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- GW limma trajectories ---\n")
  gw_nominal_names <- gw_limma_results %>%
    filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)

  if (length(gw_nominal_names) > 0) {
    cat(length(gw_nominal_names), "compound(s)\n")
    gw_traj_suffixes <- gw_limma_results %>%
      filter(Name %in% gw_nominal_names) %>%
      arrange(match(Name, gw_nominal_names)) %>%
      mutate(suffix = sprintf("logFC=%.2f | p=%.3f | FDR=%.3f", logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)) %>%
      pull(suffix)
    gw_traj_plots <- build_trajectory_plots(gw_nominal_names, eset, title_suffixes = gw_traj_suffixes)
    save_trajectory_grids(gw_traj_plots,
      paste0("gw_limma_trajectories_", scope),
      png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path
    )
  } else {
    cat("No GW limma nominal hits — skipping trajectories.\n")
  }

  # ── Sex limma trajectories (nominal p < 0.05) ─────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- Sex limma trajectories ---\n")
  sex_nominal_names <- sex_limma_results %>%
    filter(P.Value < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)

  if (length(sex_nominal_names) > 0) {
    cat(length(sex_nominal_names), "compound(s)\n")
    sex_traj_suffixes <- sex_limma_results %>%
      filter(Name %in% sex_nominal_names) %>%
      arrange(match(Name, sex_nominal_names)) %>%
      mutate(suffix = sprintf("logFC=%.2f | p=%.3f | FDR=%.3f", logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val)) %>%
      pull(suffix)
    sex_traj_plots <- build_trajectory_plots(sex_nominal_names, eset, title_suffixes = sex_traj_suffixes)
    save_trajectory_grids(sex_traj_plots,
      paste0("sex_limma_trajectories_", scope),
      png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path
    )
  } else {
    cat("No sex limma nominal hits — skipping trajectories.\n")
  }

  # ── PLS-DA (guard: need >= 2 features and adequate group sizes) ──────────────
  cat("\n--- PLS-DA ---\n")

  plsda_matrix <- t(exprs(eset))
  sex_labels <- factor(pData(eset)$Sex)
  min_group_size <- min(table(sex_labels))
  safe_ncomp <- min(5, min_group_size - 1, n_features - 1)

  if (safe_ncomp < 1) {
    cat("Skipping PLS-DA: insufficient features or group size for scope =", scope, "\n")
  } else {
    plsda_matrix_imputed <- apply(plsda_matrix, 2, min_value_impute)

    cat("Group sizes:", table(sex_labels), "\n")
    cat("Using ncomp =", safe_ncomp, "\n")

    set.seed(42)
    plsda_fit <- opls(
      x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
      y         = sex_labels,
      predI     = safe_ncomp,
      orthoI    = 0,
      permI     = 0,
      fig.pdfC  = "none",
      info.txtC = "none"
    )

    plsda_scores <- data.frame(
      Comp1 = plsda_fit@scoreMN[, 1],
      Comp2 = if (safe_ncomp >= 2) plsda_fit@scoreMN[, 2] else 0,
      Sex   = sex_labels
    )

    score_plot <- ggplot(plsda_scores, aes(x = Comp1, y = Comp2, color = Sex)) +
      geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c("F" = "tomato", "M" = "steelblue")) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = "Component 1", y = "Component 2",
        title = paste0("PLS-DA Score Plot - Steroids (", scope, ")")
      ) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    save_dual_format(score_plot, paste0("sex_plsda_scores_", scope),
      png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path
    )
    print(score_plot)

    vip_df <- data.frame(
      Name      = colnames(plsda_matrix_imputed),
      VIP_comp1 = as.numeric(getVipVn(plsda_fit))
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(VIP_comp1)) %>%
      left_join(fData(eset) %>% dplyr::select(Name, Compound.ID, Sub.Class, Class),
        by = "Name"
      ) %>%
      mutate(Name_display = truncate_labels(Name))

    vip_plot <- ggplot(vip_df, aes(x = reorder(Name, VIP_comp1), y = VIP_comp1)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(vip_df$Name_display, vip_df$Name)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = "Compound",
        y = "VIP Score (Component 1)",
        title = paste0("PLS-DA VIP Scores - Steroids (", scope, ")"),
        caption = "Red dashed line = VIP > 1"
      ) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    save_dual_format(vip_plot, paste0("sex_plsda_vip_", scope),
      png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path,
      label_lookup = build_label_lookup(vip_df$Name)
    )
    print(vip_plot)
    write_csv(
      vip_df,
      file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_plsda_vip.csv"))
    )

    # PLS-DA permutation
    set.seed(42)
    plsda_perm <- opls(
      x         = plsda_matrix_imputed,
      y         = sex_labels,
      predI     = safe_ncomp,
      orthoI    = 0,
      permI     = 1000,
      fig.pdfC  = "none",
      info.txtC = "none"
    )
    cat("\nPLS-DA permutation results:\n")
    print(plsda_perm@summaryDF)

    # Plot permuted R2Y and Q2 distributions vs observed
    perm_data <- data.frame(
      R2Y = plsda_perm@suppLs$permMN[, "R2Y(cum)"],
      Q2  = plsda_perm@suppLs$permMN[, "Q2(cum)"]
    )

    observed_R2Y <- plsda_fit@summaryDF[1, "R2Y(cum)"]
    observed_Q2  <- plsda_fit@summaryDF[1, "Q2(cum)"]

    perm_plot <- ggplot(perm_data) +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = R2Y, fill = "R2Y"), alpha = 0.5, bins = 20) +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = Q2,  fill = "Q2"),  alpha = 0.5, bins = 20) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = observed_R2Y, color = "#571C90", linewidth = 1,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = observed_Q2, color = "#1B5E20", linewidth = 1,
        linetype = "dashed"
      ) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("R2Y" = "#571C90", "Q2" = "#1B5E20"),
        name = "Metric"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      labs(
        x = "Permuted value", y = "Count",
        title = paste0("PLS-DA Permutation Test (1000 permutations) - Steroids (", scope, ")"),
        caption = "Dashed lines = observed model values; histograms = permuted null distribution"
      ) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

    save_dual_format(perm_plot, paste0("sex_plsda_permutation_", scope),
      png_path = png_path, svg_path = svg_path
    )
    print(perm_plot)

  }

  # ── UpSet Plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  cat("\n--- UpSet Overlap ---\n")

  sex_wilcoxon_fdr <- metabolite_sex_stats %>%
    filter(FDR < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)
  sex_wilcoxon_nominal <- metabolite_sex_stats %>%
    filter(p_value < 0.05 & FDR >= 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)
  sex_limma_fdr_hits <- sex_limma_results %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)
  sex_limma_nominal <- sex_limma_results %>%
    filter(P.Value < 0.05 & adj.P.Val >= 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)
  gw_corr_fdr <- gw_corr_stats %>%
    filter(GW_FDR < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)
  gw_limma_fdr_hits <- gw_limma_results %>%
    filter(adj.P.Val < 0.05) %>%
    pull(Name)

  all_names <- unique(c(
    sex_wilcoxon_fdr, sex_wilcoxon_nominal,
    sex_limma_fdr_hits, sex_limma_nominal,
    gw_corr_fdr, gw_limma_fdr_hits
  ))
  
  n_nonempty_sets <- sum(c(length(sex_wilcoxon_fdr) > 0,
                         length(sex_wilcoxon_nominal)  > 0,
                         length(sex_limma_fdr_hits)  > 0, 
                         length(sex_limma_nominal)  > 0,
                         length(gw_corr_fdr)  > 0,
                         length(gw_limma_fdr_hits)  > 0
                         ))

  if (length(all_names) > 0 && n_nonempty_sets >= 2) {
    upset_df <- data.frame(
      Name              = all_names,
      Sex_Wilcoxon_FDR  = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_wilcoxon_fdr),
      Sex_Wilcoxon_nom  = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_wilcoxon_nominal),
      Sex_limma_FDR     = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_limma_fdr_hits),
      Sex_limma_nom     = as.integer(all_names %in% sex_limma_nominal),
      GW_corr_FDR       = as.integer(all_names %in% gw_corr_fdr),
      GW_limma_FDR      = as.integer(all_names %in% gw_limma_fdr_hits)
    )

    png(file.path(png_path, paste0("upset_overlap_", scope, ".png")),
      width = 12, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300
    )
    upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
      order.by        = "freq",
      decreasing      = TRUE,
      main.bar.color  = "grey30",
      text.scale      = 1.3,
      mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
      sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method"
    )
    dev.off()

    upset(upset_df %>% dplyr::select(-Name),
      order.by        = "freq",
      decreasing      = TRUE,
      main.bar.color  = "grey30",
      text.scale      = 1.3,
      mainbar.y.label = "Compounds in Intersection",
      sets.x.label    = "Compounds per Method"
    )

    write_csv(
      upset_df,
      file.path(csv_path, paste0("batch2_steroid_", scope, "_upset.csv"))
    )
  } else if (length(all_names) > 0) {
  cat("Nominal hits found in only one method — UpSet plot requires ≥ 2 sets. Skipping.\n")
  cat("Nominal hits:", paste(all_names, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("No significant hits for UpSet plot in scope:", scope, "\n")
  }

  cat("\n--- Scope", toupper(scope), "complete ---\n\n")
}
```
